preconditions.description: The number of intervals is at most 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= 1000 for interval in intervals for x, y in interval)
preconditions.description: Each interval's start and end are within the range [0, 1000].

postconditions.description: The output list contains at least one interval.

postconditions.expression: all(x <= y for interval in output for x, y in interval)
postconditions.description: Each interval in the output is sorted and non-overlapping.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(x <= z <= y < w for (x, y) in output for (z, w) in output if x != z or y != w) for (x, y) in output)
postconditions.description: No two intervals in the output overlap.
The output intervals are sorted by their start values.
